---
title: "Assignments + Projects"
description: "A project-focused Quarto site for Aryan Lokagariwar."
---

::: {.workbench-page data-page="home"}
<section class="hero-panel" aria-labelledby="site-title">
<div class="hero-grid">
<div class="hero-copy">
<p class="eyebrow">AR3573 / Course Workbench</p>
<h1 id="site-title">Assignments + Projects</h1>
<p class="hero-kicker">Deliverables, repos, reports, demos, methods, and build evidence. No filler.</p>
<div class="command-row" role="search">
<label class="sr-only" for="work-search">Search assignments and projects</label>
<input id="work-search" class="work-search" type="search" placeholder="Search work, stack, status, artifact..." autocomplete="off">
<div class="filter-set" aria-label="Work filters">
<button class="filter-chip is-active" type="button" data-filter="All">All</button>
<button class="filter-chip" type="button" data-filter="Assignment">Assignments</button>
<button class="filter-chip" type="button" data-filter="Project">Projects</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="system-panel" aria-label="Work index status">
<div class="system-line">
<span>Index</span>
<strong data-count="total">0</strong>
</div>
<div class="system-line">
<span>Assignments</span>
<strong data-count="assignments">0</strong>
</div>
<div class="system-line">
<span>Projects</span>
<strong data-count="projects">0</strong>
</div>
<div class="system-line">
<span>Stacks</span>
<strong data-count="stacks">0</strong>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="control-strip" aria-label="Current work filters">
<div>
<p class="section-label">Current Scope</p>
<h2>Work sorted by execution value.</h2>
</div>
<div class="sort-control">
<label for="work-sort">Sort</label>
<select id="work-sort" class="work-sort">
<option value="priority">Priority</option>
<option value="recent">Most recent</option>
<option value="type">Type</option>
<option value="status">Status</option>
</select>
</div>
</section>

<section id="work-grid" class="work-grid" aria-live="polite"></section>

<section class="matrix-section" aria-labelledby="matrix-title">
<div class="section-heading">
<p class="section-label">Stack Matrix</p>
<h2 id="matrix-title">Methods, tools, and artifacts used across the work.</h2>
</div>
<div id="stack-matrix" class="stack-matrix"></div>
</section>
:::
